notes.summary: Folio 71 introduces a full sub-contrée by two closure conditions and adds C6 with two order diagrams and marginal refinements. All ink is manuscript. One worked initial is kept as one position; both diagrams, insertion arms, marginal pointer, rules and detached points are drawn.
notes.math_reading_decisions: No theorem was proved or independently validated. Comparing the two distinct order shapes, the roof over F, capped map links, and the literal H versus square-node G prime drew attention to local signs; visible ink alone determined or preserved each reading. The lowered ticks on G and the last F prime remain uncertain.
notes.author_checks: The author writes H in the existence clause but G prime in the square. This inconsistency is transcribed without repair. The oblique question explicitly leaves arbitrary versus finite suprema open. No external mathematical inference was used.
notes.title_dates_pagination: Visible running folio 71; headings Définition 1 and C6. No date or page count. The lowest line reaches the sheet edge.
